def test_decode_cyclic():
    # decode is inverse of encode for full 3-char groups
    assert decode_cyclic("bca") == "abc"
    assert decode_cyclic("cab") == "bca"
    assert decode_cyclic("abc") == "cab"

    # groups with < 3 chars are unchanged
    assert decode_cyclic("") == ""
    assert decode_cyclic("a") == "a"
    assert decode_cyclic("ab") == "ab"

    # round-trip: decode(encode(s)) == s
    for s in ["", "a", "ab", "abc", "abcd", "abcde", "hello", "abcdef", "123456789"]:
        assert decode_cyclic(encode_cyclic(s)) == s
        assert encode_cyclic(decode_cyclic(s)) == s
